competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Strong on Italian GP/LP fund data (SGRs, closed-end FIA funds, fundraising, LP commitments from casse di previdenza and fondazioni); weak on sub-institutional deals and service-graph entities.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Banca d'Italia SGR/SICAF albi, COVIP pension fund albo and annual reports, ACRI/AdEPP annual reports, fund annual reports filed at Registro Imprese, AIFI/PwC semi-annual market statistics.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Good Italian PE/VC deal and valuation coverage, cap tables reconstructed from filings; patchy on private debt, NPL and real assets.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Registro Imprese/InfoCamere company filings (via commercial resellers), Borsa Italiana/Euronext listing notices, Gazzetta Ufficiale, press (Il Sole 24 Ore, MF, BeBeez).

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Best-in-class Italian startup/VC ecosystem mapping (runs co-branded ecosystem reports with local agencies); little depth beyond VC.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: startup.registroimprese.it innovative-startup special section (public downloadable register), Italian Tech Alliance and CDP Venture Capital announcements, startup press (StartupItalia, Startupbusiness, EU-Startups).

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Broad but shallow Italian startup/funding-round coverage, heavily crowd-sourced; weak entity hygiene (duplicates, stale statuses).
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Press releases and startup media, self-reported profiles; the underlying verifiable layer is the same innovative-startup register and funding announcements we can ingest directly.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: THE local benchmark: Italian private equity, venture, private debt, NPL and M&A deal database built on 10+ years of BeBeez reporting; subscription product, do not scrape.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Own newsroom reporting plus Registro Imprese filings, Borsa Italiana notices, Gazzetta Ufficiale, court/insolvency announcements — all public routes we can go to directly.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Dominant Italian company-information and credit-risk group (also a major NPL servicer via Cerved Credit Management); full financials on all Italian companies.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Bulk licensed InfoCamere/Registro Imprese feed (bilanci, cariche, soci), Gazzetta Ufficiale and court/insolvency records, protesti registers — the register-grade layer is reachable via Telemaco, just paid.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Credit bureau + business information on Italian companies (Margò/SkyMinder products); strong on credit events and ownership chains.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Same InfoCamere registry ingest, Banca d'Italia intermediary lists, insolvency/PVP auction data.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: AIDA is the standard academic/PE screening database for Italian company financials (10 yrs of accounts, ownership); licensed product.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: InfoCamere financial statements and shareholder filings — originals are obtainable per-document from registroimprese.it/Telemaco.

competitorAnalysis.platform: Leanus + local observatories (Osservatori Politecnico di Milano, AIFI/PwC, Osservatorio VeM)
competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Leanus: Italian financial-statement analytics platform; the PoliMi startup/VC observatories and AIFI/PwC and VeM reports are the reference market statistics for Italian VC/PE — free PDF layers we can cite.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Registro Imprese accounts (Leanus), AIFI member surveys, innovative-startup register, public deal press — the free report PDFs themselves are usable signal sources.

searchedButAbsent: Searched for but genuinely absent or restricted: (1) a FREE bulk/open-data dump of the full Registro Imprese — does not exist; machine route is the paid InfoCamere Telemaco contract/API, free layer is per-company search only; (2) public UBO register access — the Italian titolare-effettivo register at the Chambers of Commerce is suspended for general public access after the 2022 CJEU ruling and pending Italian litigation (consistent with project rule: never assume open UBO data); (3) a separate fund-administrator licensee list — Italy has no standalone fund-admin license; depositaries and ManCos sit inside the Banca d'Italia albi; (4) a national machine-readable bar roll — lawyer albi are held per local Ordine; CNF-level bulk download not found; (5) official public RSS for Milano Finanza, CONSOB, We Wealth and Focus Risparmio — hunted /rss, /feed variants, none confirmed working; (6) a national carbon account-holder bulk list from ISPRA — account-level EU ETS data is published at EU level (EUTL), not by the Italian administrator; (7) PVP insolvency-auction open-data/API for the general public — interoperability API exists but only for accredited advertising sites. Nothing in the catalog below is padded: every URL was either fetched directly or returned by search as the canonical page; unverified ones are flagged in their verdicts.

sources.name: Registro Imprese (InfoCamere) — Italian Business Register
sources.verdict: Canonical register of ~6M companies (filings, officers, shareholders, bilanci); no free bulk — machine route is the paid Telemaco contract + InfoCamere API; per-document purchases work at low volume. Highest-value paid source in Italy.

sources.name: Registro Imprese — sezione speciale Startup e PMI innovative
sources.verdict: Free public special section listing ALL innovative startups and innovative SMEs (the register Dealroom builds on); dashboard + periodically refreshed downloadable lists — the one truly open slice of the company register, verified live.

sources.name: Banca d'Italia — Albi ed elenchi di vigilanza (supervisory registers)
sources.verdict: Master registers for banks, SGR (AIFM/UCITS sections), SICAV/SICAF, art.106 financial intermediaries, payment/e-money institutions, depositaries; searchable online service with historical data — core GP/ManCo spine for Italy, verified via search.

sources.name: Banca d'Italia — CASP (MiCA) authorization section
sources.verdict: Post-MiCA crypto authorizations sit with Banca d'Italia/Consob (transitional regime to 30 Jun 2026); authorized CASPs appear in the Bank's albi + ESMA register — pair with the legacy OAM VASP list during transition.

sources.name: OAM — Organismo Agenti e Mediatori (incl. legacy VASP register)
sources.verdict: Public registers of credit agents/brokers plus the legacy crypto (VASP) register still relevant through the MiCA transition; consultable online, verified via search — historical crypto-operator population source.

sources.name: CONSOB — registers (imprese di investimento, emittenti, albi) + Bollettino
sources.verdict: Investment-firm and issuer registers plus the Bollettino where SGR/SICAF register changes are published; site sits behind Radware bot protection (as hinted) — pages resolve in search but automated fetch is unreliable; plan browser-grade crawling or manual pulls.

sources.name: COVIP — Albo dei fondi pensione + open data
sources.verdict: Complete register of Italian pension funds (the LP side) with per-fund sheets, cost/return datasets and a dedicated open-data page (covip.it/open-data) — high-yield, machine-friendly, verified via search.

sources.name: IVASS — Albo imprese di assicurazione + RUI intermediary register
sources.verdict: Insurance company albo and the RUI intermediaries register with CSV/open-data export updated weekly — insurer LPs and distribution graph at near-zero cost, verified via search.

sources.name: OCF — Albo unico dei consulenti finanziari
sources.verdict: National register of financial advisors (individuals + SCF advisory firms), searchable only on OCF portal; useful for the service graph's advisory layer, verified via search.

sources.name: Gazzetta Ufficiale della Repubblica Italiana
sources.verdict: Official gazette free in digital form since 2013; per-issue HTML/PDF with text search, reuse allowed with attribution; no official bulk API but structure is crawlable (community projects and a HuggingFace corpus prove parseability).

sources.name: Portale delle Vendite Pubbliche (Ministero della Giustizia)
sources.verdict: National portal of ALL judicial sales from enforcement and insolvency proceedings (incl. whole going-concern aziende); public search UI crawlable; formal API only for accredited advertisers — key NPL/distressed signal, verified live.

sources.name: Elenco dei gestori della crisi d'impresa (Ministry of Justice)
sources.verdict: National list of insolvency practitioners eligible as curatore/commissario/liquidatore under the Crisis Code (replaced the old Albo in 2024); public portal, verified via search — fills the insolvency-practitioner roll requirement.

sources.name: Borsa Italiana / Euronext Milan — listed companies, notices, IPO admissions
sources.verdict: ~430 issuers across Euronext Milan/EGM/MIV; company directory, avvisi di borsa and admission notices crawlable on borsaitaliana.it, with Euronext Live as the group-level data layer; no open bulk API but pages are stable and parseable.

sources.name: AIFI — Italian Private Equity, Venture Capital and Private Debt Association
sources.verdict: ~107 full + ~125 associate members = the Italian GP population plus advisors; directory pages exist (soci/associati and soci/aderenti) but the site returned HTTP 500 during verification — retry needed; semi-annual AIFI/PwC stats PDFs are a bonus.

sources.name: Italian Tech Alliance (ex VC Hub Italia) — investor members
sources.verdict: The Italian VC/innovation-investor association (VC SGRs, CVCs, angel groups, family offices); member/board pages public, verified via search — complements AIFI on the venture side.

sources.name: ABI — Associazione Bancaria Italiana, elenco associati
sources.verdict: Full member list published as a dated PDF (Feb 2026 edition verified in search results), refreshed monthly-ish on abi.it — simple deterministic parse of the Italian banking population.

sources.name: Assogestioni — asset management association
sources.verdict: Represents Italian ManCos/SGRs; publishes quarterly 'Mappa del Risparmio Gestito' with per-company AUM tables (PDF/xls) — associate list and data reports public, though directory URL not individually fetch-verified this run.

sources.name: Assilea — Italian Leasing Association
sources.verdict: ~200 leasing companies (asset-backed lending population); member info public on site, verified only via search — crawl to confirm directory structure.

sources.name: Assifact — Italian Factoring Association, gli Associati
sources.verdict: 31 factoring banks/intermediaries + service members listed on a plain associates page (trade/supply-chain finance vertical), verified via search.

sources.name: ANIA — Associazione Nazionale fra le Imprese Assicuratrici
sources.verdict: Insurance industry association (insurer LPs); publishes member lists and the ANIA statistical yearbooks; URL canonical but directory route not fetch-verified this run.

sources.name: ACRI — banking foundations (fondazioni di origine bancaria)
sources.verdict: ~83 banking foundations — a distinctive Italian LP class with mandatory annual reports; ACRI contacts page lists them all and the annual Rapporto PDF gives assets/allocations, verified via search.

sources.name: AdEPP — Associazione degli Enti Previdenziali Privati (casse di previdenza)
sources.verdict: ~20 private professional pension funds (major Italian alternatives LPs — Cassa Forense, ENPAM, Inarcassa...); association site lists members and reports; existence verified via search, site not fetch-verified — confirm URL on crawl.

sources.name: CDP — Cassa Depositi e Prestiti (press + participations)
sources.verdict: The national promotional institution: equity participations, funds, infra investments disclosed in press releases and financial reports (semi-annual PDFs verified); anchor node of the Italian LP/DFI graph.

sources.name: CDP Venture Capital SGR — Fondo Nazionale Innovazione
sources.verdict: The dominant Italian VC LP/GP (70% CDP Equity, 30% Invitalia); funds and portfolio disclosed on site and via press; canonical URL, portfolio-page structure to confirm on crawl.

sources.name: Fondo Italiano d'Investimento SGR
sources.verdict: State-anchored PE/fund-of-funds platform (CDP + banks) with public portfolio and funds pages; URL canonical, not fetch-verified this run.

sources.name: Invitalia — national investment promotion agency
sources.verdict: Runs startup/SME incentive programs (Smart&Start etc.) whose beneficiary and program data generate deal-adjacent signals; press and open-administration sections crawlable.

sources.name: SIMEST (Gruppo CDP) — internationalization equity investor
sources.verdict: Equity portfolio of 220+ investee projects plus a MAECI venture-capital fund co-investing with CDP VC; press releases (verified via search) name investees — steady co-investment signal.

sources.name: MEF Dipartimento del Tesoro — Partecipazioni pubbliche open data (Patrimonio PA)
sources.verdict: Annual CC-BY 4.0 open dataset of ALL shareholdings held by Italian public administrations (state/local ownership graph, privatization pipeline); latest release Mar 2026; companion BDAP catalog at bdap-opendata.rgs.mef.gov.it — verified via search.

sources.name: ANAC — open data appalti (BDNCP, OCDS)
sources.verdict: All public contracts >EUR 40k in OCDS JSON/CSV, monthly dumps plus a Swagger REST API with near-real-time data — best-in-class procurement source (concessionaires, EPC contractors, infra), verified via search.

sources.name: ISPRA — Registro Italiano Emission Trading (EU ETS national administrator)
sources.verdict: ISPRA administers the Italian section of the Union Registry (operators authorized by the Comitato ETS); account-holder detail lives in the EU EUTL — use ISPRA for national operator decisions, EUTL for bulk data; verified via search.

sources.name: GSE — Gestore dei Servizi Energetici (CO2 auctions + renewables registers)
sources.verdict: State energy-services operator: EU ETS auction reports, renewable incentive registers and counterparty lists — feeds the energy-transition asset class; site crawlable, verified via search.

sources.name: ARERA — energy regulator, anagrafica operatori
sources.verdict: Regulator of electricity/gas/water; maintains an operator registry (anagrafica) covering energy companies relevant to infra investors; canonical URL but registry export route not verified this run.

sources.name: RICS — Find a Member / Find a Firm directory (Italy)
sources.verdict: Global RICS directory filters to Italy for accredited valuers (real-assets service graph); JS search form, no bulk export — low-volume lookup only; URL canonical, not fetch-verified.

sources.name: Consiglio Nazionale Forense — lawyer albi
sources.verdict: Italian bar rolls are held per local Ordine degli Avvocati; CNF is the national body — no confirmed national bulk search; treat law-firm sourcing via press/deal credits instead. Included for completeness with honest caveat.

sources.name: UNIREC — credit servicers / collection industry association
sources.verdict: Association of Italian credit-management/collection companies (NPL service graph); publishes member list and annual industry report; URL canonical, not fetch-verified this run.

sources.name: Assoimmobiliare — Confindustria real estate association
sources.verdict: Members = the institutional Italian real estate industry (developers, RE SGRs, servicers); member directory on site; URL canonical, not fetch-verified this run.

sources.name: Il Sole 24 Ore — Finanza RSS
sources.verdict: Italy's business daily of record; finanza.xml feed FETCH-VERIFIED live (items from today), full RSS hub at /rss with per-section feeds — top-priority signal source, headline+link only per compliance.

sources.name: MF - Milano Finanza
sources.verdict: The other core financial daily (deals, funds, banking); historical RSS support confirmed but no working public feed URL found (/rss 404s) — crawl section pages or use Class Editori newsletters; partial paywall.

sources.name: BeBeez.it (EdiBeez)
sources.verdict: THE Italian private-capital newswire (PE, VC, private debt, NPL, real estate); WordPress /feed/ exists but returned 403 to plain fetch (bot protection) — expect success with proper RSS client headers; premium tier paywalled.

sources.name: BeBeez International (English)
sources.verdict: English sister site with weekly Italian PE/debt/NPL roundups; /feed/ FETCH-VERIFIED valid RSS updated today — easiest machine entry into BeBeez content.

sources.name: FIRSTonline
sources.verdict: Independent finance/economy daily; /feed/ FETCH-VERIFIED valid RSS, hourly updates — free, reliable general finance signal.

sources.name: ANSA — Economia
sources.verdict: National newswire economy channel; RSS FETCH-VERIFIED valid — high-volume baseline feed for corporate/M&A events.

sources.name: Corriere della Sera — Economia
sources.verdict: Top general daily's economy section; RSS FETCH-VERIFIED valid (feed serves ~30 items) — good macro/corporate context feed.

sources.name: la Repubblica — Economia & Finanza
sources.verdict: Second general daily; the long-standing rss2.0.xml URL is widely referenced but the domain blocked our fetcher — verify from production IPs before relying on it.

sources.name: Teleborsa
sources.verdict: Market newswire with a public RSS hub FETCH-VERIFIED (/feed/rss all news, /feed/rss/energia, /feed/rss/banche) — free for non-commercial use, check terms for commercial ingestion.

sources.name: Radiocor (Il Sole 24 Ore agency) via Borsa Italiana news pages
sources.verdict: Exchange-distributed newswire (finanza/economia archives, timestamped) — no public RSS found but archive pages are stable and parseable; closest thing to an exchange news feed for Milan.

sources.name: StartupItalia
sources.verdict: Leading startup/VC outlet; WordPress /feed/ exists but 403'd our fetcher (bot shield) — likely fine with RSS-client headers.

sources.name: Startupbusiness.it
sources.verdict: Veteran startup-ecosystem publication; /feed/ FETCH-VERIFIED valid RSS — complements StartupItalia on funding rounds.

sources.name: EconomyUp
sources.verdict: Digital-innovation/open-innovation outlet (Digital360 group) covering CVC and startup finance; feed URL not verified this run — probe /feed/ on crawl.

sources.name: We Wealth
sources.verdict: Wealth-management/private-markets vertical; /feed returned empty — no working RSS found; crawl section pages if needed.

sources.name: FundsPeople Italia
sources.verdict: Asset-management trade press (SGR launches, mandates, private-markets funds); /it/feed/ FETCH-VERIFIED valid RSS hourly — strong fund-industry signal.

sources.name: Focus Risparmio (Assogestioni)
sources.verdict: Assogestioni's own magazine on the fund industry; /feed 404 — no RSS found; site crawlable.

sources.name: Bluerating
sources.verdict: Asset-management/advisory trade daily; /feed 403'd plain fetch (bot shield) — retry with RSS-client headers.

sources.name: Credit Village
sources.verdict: The Italian NPL/credit-management trade portal (servicer deals, portfolio sales); /feed/ FETCH-VERIFIED valid RSS updated today — core private-debt/NPL signal.

sources.name: Dealflower
sources.verdict: Legal/finance deal outlet (M&A, PE, advisors); WordPress /feed/ 403'd plain fetch — likely works with proper headers.

sources.name: Financecommunity (LC Publishing Group)
sources.verdict: Deal + advisor-league coverage (sister of Legalcommunity for law-firm mandates — mine both for the service graph); /feed/ 403'd plain fetch, retry with client headers.

sources.name: Monitorimmobiliare
sources.verdict: Main institutional real estate news portal (RE funds/SGR deals); /rss 403'd — feed existence unconfirmed; section pages crawlable with browser-grade client.

sources.name: Requadro
sources.verdict: Institutional real estate weekly; /feed FETCH-VERIFIED valid RSS — reliable RE signal at zero cost.

sources.name: Il Quotidiano Immobiliare (ilQI)
sources.verdict: Subscription real estate daily with strong institutional coverage; mostly paywalled, no feed verified — headline layer only.

sources.name: QualEnergia.it
sources.verdict: Sustainable-energy market portal (renewables/transition deals and policy); /feed/ FETCH-VERIFIED valid RSS hourly — feeds the real-assets/energy class.

sources.name: Staffetta Quotidiana
sources.verdict: The historic Italian energy daily; heavily paywalled, no feed found — optional headline crawl only.

sources.name: Banca d'Italia — press releases + RSS/e-mail alert service
sources.verdict: Central-bank press channel with a dedicated RSS alert hub (topic-selectable) verified via search — authorizations, sanctions and supervisory news signal.

sources.name: CONSOB Informa — weekly newsletter
sources.verdict: Weekly digest of Commission decisions (authorizations, register changes, warnings), English edition each Monday; behind the same Radware shield as the registers — parse via browser-grade fetch.

sources.name: MEF — Ministry of Economy and Finance press room
sources.verdict: Privatizations, state holdings, guarantee schemes (GACS successors) announced here; press index crawlable; #openmef open-data page exists — no RSS confirmed.

sources.name: Itinerari Previdenziali (think tank + annual investor reports)
sources.verdict: Publishes THE annual census of Italian institutional investors (casse, fondazioni, fondi pensione) with alternatives allocations — free PDF layer maps the LP universe; site not fetch-verified this run.

sources.name: AIFI/PwC statistics + Osservatorio VeM and PoliMi observatory reports
sources.verdict: Free semi-annual PE/VC/private-debt market statistics PDFs — the citable market-size layer for Italy; AIFI site was erroring (500) during checks, PDFs usually mirrored in press coverage.
